info.title: nthstock API
info.description: REST API of nthstock, a paper-trading platform on simulated NSE/BSE data. Money is integer paise; times are UTC ISO 8601. Every non-2xx response uses the ApiError envelope. Generated from packages/contracts; do not edit by hand.

cookieAuth.name: nth_at
cookieAuth.description: Access JWT cookie set by the auth routes. State-changing requests must also send the session's CSRF token in the x-csrf-token header.

bearerAuth.description: The same access JWT as an Authorization header (no CSRF header needed).
